what: Observed run-to-run spread of walk.sh at one commit, cold, no cache.
readThisFirst: TWO repeats give an observed SPREAD, not a band. noise-bands.json used three.
Treat these as a lower bound on the true spread: a third run can only widen it.
A delta inside the spread is unresolvable. A delta many times it is real.
novel and realLines were byte-identical across both runs. That band is ZERO,
measured rather than assumed, and any movement in either refutes a change
outright — it means real source change was lost.

matcherIsExact.finding: Every matcher counter was IDENTICAL across both runs, digit for digit.
why: Matching runs to completion before the first prompt is built, so the model
cannot perturb it. All run-to-run variance lives downstream, in naming.
CONSEQUENCE: a matcher-level counter needs no band at all — compare it
directly. Only line-level KPIs need this file.
Also: the position-based scope-ordinal rung fires 45 times of 3500 here,
1.3%. exp065b measured 282 on 85->86; that figure does not transfer.

supersedes.correction: That belongs to experiments/034-eval-harness/noise-bands.json, a DIFFERENT instrument. It was quoted against a walk delta on 2026-08-18 and should not have been. The walk's own spread is measured here.
